title: Prepare for a stage-gate review
summary: A stage gate is a formal review before moving to the next phase or funding. Prepare evidence, not paperwork, and treat it as a chance to get help.

beginner: Find out what the gate needs to see and who decides.
Gather the evidence: research, results, plans, risks and costs.
Tell the story clearly: what you learned, what you will do next and why.
Meet the decision-makers beforehand to hear concerns.
Record the decision and any conditions.
experienced: Push for gates based on evidence of value and risk, not documents.
Use gates to secure resources and remove blockers.
Help shape governance to support agile delivery.

canDelegateTo.task: Prepare the plan, risks and costs

toolExamples.sharepoint-word: Use the governance template and keep it short.
toolExamples.confluence: Link the gate pack to live evidence rather than copying it.
toolExamples.power-bi: Show progress and cost charts in the pack.

pitfalls: Treating the gate as a test rather than help
